example: FROM python:3.11 AS builder; FROM python:3.11-slim AS runtime
anti_pattern: Single fat image with build tools in runtime
notes: Runtime image should be slim; only copy compiled artifacts

anti_pattern: USER root or no USER directive
notes: Required for production; prevents container escape

description: Exclude dev/CI artifacts from build context
anti_pattern: No .dockerignore; large context sent to daemon
notes: Missing .git in dockerignore causes large context + leaks

example: COPY requirements.txt .; RUN pip install; COPY . .
anti_pattern: COPY . . first breaks cache on every code change
notes: Requirements rarely change; code changes every commit

anti_pattern: No cache mount; full reinstall every build

description: Never ARG SECRET or ENV SECRET in Dockerfile
Set restart policy for prod services
anti_pattern: No restart policy; service down after crash
notes: always vs unless-stopped: prefer unless-stopped (respects manual stop)

description: Wait for dependency to be healthy
Load env from file not inline
Ensure new image used on deploy
anti_pattern: docker compose up -d (may keep old container)
notes: Without --force-recreate the old container image stays

anti_pattern: Bind mount to host path for DB data
notes: Named volumes survive docker compose down; bind mounts don't
